stories.title: Councillor calls for information on unlicensed HMOs in Sandycroft and Pentre
stories.summary: A councillor has appealed for residents to come forward with information on potentially unlicensed Houses in Multiple Occupation in Sandycroft and Pentre. Cllr Christine Jones, who represents Queensferry and Sealand, said the two areas have a high saturation of HMOs, many of which may not be compliant with regulations and registration. stories.title: Mold Town Council launches free litter picking equipment loan scheme
stories.summary: Mold Town Council is offering free loans of litter picking equipment to residents, schools, community groups and businesses across the town.
